meta.title: A good BOQ upload builds the tabbed grid and saves the lines to the project
gaps: Enable or verify the boq_in_erfx_allowed tenant gate; it must be supplied as a precondition.
Upload the valid two-tab BOQ workbook: upload supports only the listed PDF, PNG, CSV and TXT fixtures, and no domain step supplies this workbook.
Assert that POST /templates/product_sheet_params precedes PATCH /event_groups/<id>; expect_request can check individual requests but not their relative order.

Compare uploaded tabs, section numbers, section widgets, descriptions, A.1-style line numbers and note-row file icons against the required workbook; the fixture contents and supported icon targets are unavailable.
Call get_line_items after a stage exists and compare persisted project lines with the workbook; no catalog step performs this oracle.
